rows:
When provided, sets the authentication
mechanism to use if AMPS cannot identify the
type of authentication token provided by the
connection.
In this release, the value for this parameter can
be either Kerberos or LDAP.
There is no default for this option. If no
DefaultAuthenticationMechanism is
configured and AMPS cannot identify the type
of authentication token provided by a
connection, AMPS reports an error for that
logon.
